differences.title: 1. SCHEMA DEFINITION
differences.leftDesc: Prisma uses a dedicated SDL file for schema definition, which is then introspected to generate a client and migrations. This separation enforces a single source of truth.
differences.rightDesc: Drizzle ORM defines schemas directly in TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing for type inference and compile-time checks within your application code.

differences.title: 2. MIGRATION SYSTEM
differences.leftDesc: Prisma provides a robust, opinionated migration system with `prisma migrate dev` and `prisma migrate deploy` commands, generating SQL files.
differences.rightDesc: Drizzle ORM relies on external tools or manual SQL generation for migrations, offering more flexibility but requiring more setup.

differences.title: 3. TYPE SAFETY
differences.leftDesc: Prisma generates a fully type-safe client based on your schema, providing excellent autocompletion and compile-time guarantees for queries.
differences.rightDesc: Drizzle ORM leverages TypeScript's type system for its query builder, achieving type safety through inference and generic types.

differences.title: 4. SQL GENERATION
differences.leftDesc: Prisma abstracts SQL generation, translating your JavaScript/TypeScript queries into SQL. You interact with a client, not raw SQL.
differences.rightDesc: Drizzle ORM acts as a SQL query builder, producing type-safe SQL strings that are then executed by a database driver.

differences.title: 5. DATABASE SUPPORT
differences.leftDesc: Prisma supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, and MongoDB, offering a unified API across these databases.
differences.rightDesc: Drizzle ORM primarily targets PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQLite, with an emphasis on SQL compliance and performance for these.

differences.title: 6. QUERY PERFORMANCE
differences.leftDesc: Prisma's abstraction layer can introduce minor overhead compared to raw SQL, though it's highly optimized for common operations.
differences.rightDesc: Drizzle ORM generates efficient SQL, resulting in performance very close to writing raw SQL queries directly.

differences.title: 7. ECOSYSTEM & TOOLING
differences.leftDesc: Prisma offers an integrated developer experience with Prisma Studio (GUI), client generation, and migrations as a cohesive package.
differences.rightDesc: Drizzle ORM is more modular, focusing on the query builder and type safety, often integrating with other tools for migrations or tooling.
